Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which 
 must be carried out every month as indicated by M1 in the above title block.
This equipment used for clean 
 intake water from any deposits suspended
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy, tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Ahmad Shanab, 
 revised by maintenance general manager eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana, 
 and approved by eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil 
 inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb inspection. and quality control head sector
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, 
 shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen 
 mechanically and electrically.

and Equipment

Reduced

Reducer, motor and couplings | Excessive noise, vibration or heat

Sprocket wobbling or 
 broken teeth | Replace sprocket

 (25 mm). | Adjust chain tightened to 
 reduce slac
